integrity: The general local-reset Kraus representation is derived from the cited grand-coupling map, and the quantum-channel norm is proved by new direct upper and lower estimates. Existing grand-coupling and classical coupon-collector results are credited. No independent validation or certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to finite tensor products with local dimension at least two, independently sampled site indices, and complete pure-state replacement on the selected site. Exact weighted formula but Gumbel profile only for uniform selection. Does not cover partial refresh, noncommuting quantum dynamics, mixed local targets, interacting measures, or physical implementation complexity. An earlier implicit derivation remains a priority risk.
title: Exact coupon-collector diamond mixing for product-state quantum refresh channels
